title: Nanotwin engineering enables exceptional thermal stability in p-type bismuth telluride thermoelectrics
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,1237-1249
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE06360D, Paper
Chuandong Zhou, Jiaze Zhu, Shuxin Zhang, Zhen’ao Zhang, Zongwei Zhang, Jianfeng Cai, Qiang Zhang, Ruijie Li, Lianghan Fan, Jingtao Xu, Guoqiang Liu, Xiaojian Tan, Bo Liang, Jun Jiang
Dense coherent nanotwins in p-(Bi,Sb)2Te3 suppress grain coarsening and stabilize interfaces during high-temperature service. This thermal stability enables durable thermoelectric operation without compromising electrical transport.
